<SW-01>display interface brief
PHY: Physical
*down: administratively down
^down: standby
(l): loopback
(s): spoofing
(E): E-Trunk down
(b): BFD down
(e): ETHOAM down
(d): Dampening Suppressed
(p): port alarm down
(dl): DLDP down
(c): CFM down
InUti/OutUti: input utility rate/output utility rate
